sourceAnchors.expected: Dense exact algorithm tiles Q/K/V into SRAM, combines online-softmax statistics and recomputes backward intermediates, reducing HBM traffic without making dense arithmetic linear. Theorem1: O(N^2 d) FLOPs, O(N) additional memory beyond inputs/output. Example Table1 BERT-large: 20.0±1.5 vs17.4±1.4 minutes, target72.0% masked-language accuracy,10runs,8A100; seq512 in abstract. Other faithfully owned examples are allowed; kernel benchmark on one40GB A100 with dropout/padding is distinct from end-to-end BERT/GPT.

FA2 reduces non-matmul work, parallelizes sequence blocks and partitions forward warps by Q with shared K/V; backward still has synchronization. Dense exact semantics retained. Kernel tests A10080GB SXM4 vary512–16k length/head64or128/causal masks. Table1 GPT3-2.7B8k on8A100 reports80/175/225TFLOPs/s/GPU withoutFA/FA1/FA2;225/72% is end-to-end,230/73% is kernel. Other exact owned examples allowed. p11 contains self-comparison typo; p10/Table1 clarify FA1 baseline; do not blindly turn a typo into measured self-speedup.
